   - I run no claim re-check and no whole-wave review after an own push. Claim dispositions carry to `2222…`, because no description repair ran.
   - I persist the new P4 and P5 IDs to the record.
6. **Choose the next action.**
   - There is no contract exception and no no-progress obstacle.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved in this case: both outputs record the `fix 1` grant as a named `consent.fix: { scope: ["P1"] }`, state explicitly that the grant covers only P1 so the new row-1 P4 is not covered, render a fresh menu instead of auto-running a wave, and report that no helper is dispatched in the segment, so f1 and f2 hold in Before and After alike. The Change (worktree contract from `## using-git-worktrees`, `home:` ownership match, cleanup step 2 behaviour) is not exercised by this entry point, so it is invisible here, which is the right outcome. One small drift worth watching: After's menu line for option 1 reads "retain only the selected blocker IDs for later independent reassessments during this run...", a longer and less idiomatic label than Before's "retain in-scope blocker repair during this run..."; it does not change any fact, but if the menu label is meant to be fixed text in SKILL.md, keep the wording verbatim so the rendered menu stays stable across runs while the worktree-contract edits land elsewhere in the file.
